class.name: OcgShapeanalysisShell
class.brief_description: This class provides operators to analyze edges orientation in the shell.
class.description: ! This class provides operators to analyze edges orientation ! in the shell.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears data about loaded shells and performed checks

method.name: LoadShells
method.description: Adds shells contained in the <shape> to the list of loaded shells

method.name: CheckOrientedShells
method.description: Checks if shells fulfill orientation condition, i.e. if each edge is, either present once (free edge) or twice (connected edge) but with different orientations (FORWARD/REVERSED) Edges which do not fulfill these conditions are bad

method.name: IsLoaded
method.description: Tells if a shape is loaded (only shells are checked)

method.name: NbLoaded
method.description: Returns the actual number of loaded shapes (i.e. shells)

method.name: Loaded
method.description: Returns a loaded shape specified by its rank number. Returns null shape if <num> is out of range

method.name: HasBadEdges
method.description: Tells if at least one edge is recorded as bad

method.name: BadEdges
method.description: Returns the list of bad edges as a Compound It is empty (not null) if no edge are recorded as bad

method.name: HasFreeEdges
method.description: Tells if at least one edge is recorded as free (not connected)

method.name: FreeEdges
method.description: Returns the list of free (not connected) edges as a Compound It is empty (not null) if no edge are recorded as free

method.name: HasConnectedEdges
method.description: Tells if at least one edge is connected (shared twice or more)
